name: Jamjoom Pharmaceuticals Factory Company
summary: Jamjoom Pharmaceuticals Factory Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and distribution of pharmaceutical and consumer products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Gulf, Iraq, Egypt, North Africa, and internationally. It provides human medicines; nutraceuticals; antibiotics; general analgesics; medicines for treatment of cough, allergy, asthma, heart diseases, blood pressure, diarrhea, vomiting, and ulcer and acidity; treatment of various skin infections and cancer diseases; and eye drops, and ointments and cosmeceuticals.
